World Bank aggregate 0.351821646573129 (Global Findex Database 2025, row Low income, 2021, all); reproduced as the adult-population-weighted mean of the 19 economies the file classes Low income with a 2021-wave observation, Yemen's 2022 observation included. Context only: not a benchmark, target or ranking.
percentage points (95% margin of error, design-based)
CauseWay derivation from World Bank Global Findex 2021 Yemen microdata

Point estimate 11.9%; 95% confidence interval 9.7% to 14.1%; base 1000 respondents; design effect 1.16. CauseWay derivation: Hajek ratio estimator with Taylor-linearization variance on the published survey weight (wgt) only. The public-use file carries no PSU or stratum identifier, so clustering is not captured and the true interval may be wider, never narrower. A simple binomial standard error is not used. The respondent file is held under the World Bank Microdata Research License and is never redistributed, committed to this repository or published.

Current Global Findex edition and Yemen observation coverage

The 2025 edition includes 2024 observations for many economies, but the World Bank indicator still reports Yemen's most recent account-ownership observation as 2022 (11.90%). Do not impute, interpolate or relabel a 2024 Yemen value.
